profile_text.body:
Captions is an AI video generator and editor founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York City. The company describes itself as offering AI that edits like a professional editor, with tools designed to take users from an initial idea to finished, shareable video content regardless of their editing experience. Its platform handles tasks such as automatic scene cutting, B-roll overlay, caption generation, and translated subtitle creation.

The company's primary product, Captions AI, covers a range of AI-driven video capabilities including eye contact correction, dubbing, and what the site describes as AI twin creation and digital avatar generation, where users can iterate across videos using the same avatar with prompts to adjust outfits, backgrounds, or product inserts. The site positions the product for use cases including short-form social videos, ads, tutorials, product demos, real estate listing videos, and thought leadership content, and notes that consent is a consideration in its likeness manipulation features.

The held facts show Captions carrying a notable exposure footprint in New York, with 299 associated entries under that jurisdiction, consistent with its New York City base. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the current data.
